content.text:
Failures in the report:
1. The interaction feature had no predictive power, with weak IC and a weak HAC t-stat.
2. Coverage was only about half, likely because of the long history requirement.
3. The second submission exceeded the word limit by two words.

The proposed hypothesis is a spread of expanding-window standardized variables, not an interaction. That is a different form, but it still uses stress-type variables and does not condition on regime, so the first failure is not clearly addressed. The expanding history (tsz "exp") probably still requires long history, so it does not clearly fix coverage. Expanding windows may even start with minimal history, but this is unclear.

The word limit failure: the hypothesis is about 40 words. The limit is unknown, so it is unclear whether it stays under it. The report doesn't state the limit either.

Overall, the proposal does not explicitly avoid any of the failures, and the evidence is unclear.

{"avoids_failure": null}
